about.heading: Thoughtful gifts, delivered with care
story: PresentBox started with a simple idea: gifting should feel as good as receiving. We hand-pick aesthetic, made-to-be-shared gifts — fresh flowers, small-batch cakes, cosy hampers and little things for the room — so you can find the right one in minutes.
Every order is packed by hand, includes a free message card and is delivered fresh, so it arrives looking the way it did when we packed it.
